Prophecy: The Egyptians at the Red Sea Seen No More
ProphecySummary: Standing before the Red Sea, Moses tells Israel not to fear: they will see the LORD's salvation that day, and the Egyptians they have seen that day they will see again no more for ever.
Fulfillment: Fulfilled in Exodus 14:27-28, where the sea returns on the Egyptians and covers the chariots and horsemen of Pharaoh's host, so that not so much as one of them remained.
RelatedEvents: The Exodus and the Red Sea
